resources.string: How often posters from add-ons and rating services are checked for a new picture.
Saved posters show at once; a new picture replaces them in the background. TMDB and the big artwork sites are always kept for at least a week.
New pictures soon after each start. For small Home pages and add-ons that change their artwork.
Each poster is checked at most once a day.
The default. Each poster is checked at most once a week; smoothest for big Home pages.
Fewest checks. Rating posters can be up to a month old.
